question: Is a real acquisition possible from this shell, now that C16 made live sends complete?

router_reachable.reading: The router process is up and is enforcing auth. It is not reachable as a configured gateway endpoint from this shell.

the_precise_wall: 1. SETTLEMENT_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT is unset, so Settings.from_env() yields gateway.endpoint == '' and the adapter refuses every operation with 'gateway endpoint is not configured'.
2. SETTLEMENT_GATEWAY_KEY is unset, so even a correct endpoint has no credential.

3. SETTLEMENT_EXPECTED_ROUTE is unset. scripts/inv01_study.py _v1_route_from_env refuses a live study without it before it will build an adapter, because an unpinned route is refused per-operation by HttpGatewayAdapter and a run that spends nothing and exits 0 looks like a study that ran.
verdict: A real acquisition is possible in this codebase and is not reachable from this shell. The acquisition seam is live-capable and now refuses to call a fixture an acquisition, so the honest record is fixture-stand-in until a shell with the endpoint, the key and a pinned free route runs the construction path.

what_an_adapter_built_here_actually_does.HttpGatewayAdapter.from_settings(Setting: succeeds, so construction of the object is not the blocker
what_an_adapter_built_here_actually_does.check_discovery(): GatewayError(kind=transport, message='gateway endpoint is not configured')
what_an_adapter_built_here_actually_does.conclusion: The refusal is pre-transport. No request left this shell, so nothing was billed and no unknown spend was incurred.
what_an_adapter_built_here_actually_does.infer(request): same refusal, raised before any socket is opened

what_is_no_longer_the_wall: The 2026-09-24 refusal in the invl02_live database was route_error='response_metadata' at HTTP 200 with 369 input and 2048 output tokens spent. That is a post-send metadata mismatch, and 4133de1 fixed the case-folding that caused it, so the blocker that justified a recording double is gone. The provider answered 200 and the bytes arrived. What failed was the comparison of the returned route against the frozen one.
That is why the double can be retired on the strength of the code: the live path reaches the provider. It is not retired here, because this shell has no credential to reach it with.
